note: Generated by tools/demo-capture (npm run capture). Fictional demo company — no real customer data.

tour.title: Today, at a glance
tour.caption: Every tech’s day on one board. Unscheduled jobs wait in their area of town, ready to drag onto a tech.

tour.title: Drag, drop, done
tour.caption: The job lands on Dev’s afternoon. Every other dispatcher’s screen updates live, and it appears on Dev’s phone.

tour.title: Everything about the job, one click away
tour.caption: Customer, location, access notes, equipment and history — without leaving the board.

tour.title: Plan the day on a map
tour.caption: Every job waiting to be scheduled is on one map, coloured by area, next to a tech’s day. Add the nearby ones, and OptyField puts the route in driving order before you send it to the board.

tour.title: The gym manager sees every machine
tour.caption: Each machine has its own notes, parts and price — no 5-page PDF to decipher.

tour.title: Yes to this one, not that one
tour.caption: The torn seat pad can wait. She declines that machine and keeps going — the total updates as she decides.

tour.title: Four approved, one declined
tour.caption: One response covers every machine. Partial approvals are normal — nothing gets lost in an email thread.

tour.title: The office releases only what was approved
tour.caption: The four approved machines go to parts ordering, then dispatch. The declined seat stays on file to quote again later.
